title: Building AI Research Teams for Autonomous Discovery of Linear Attention Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.28887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous agents can increasingly propose ideas, modify code, and run experiments, creating an opportunity to accelerate scientific discovery using teams of collaborative AI researchers. To escape local minima in the discovery, we propose to encourage orthogonal exploration by constructing the team using agents with varying expertise. However, realizing this design requires more than diverse backgrounds. When experiments are costly, a team can test only a limited number of ideas, thereby creating the need to balance exploration and exploitation when selecting a subset of researchers to propose and execute new experiments. Furthermore, each result should shape what the team tries next. We therefore ask how AI researchers with different scientific backgrounds can build on one another's findings and sustain progress under a limited experimental budget. translated_title: 构建AI研究团队以实现线性注意力架构的自主发现
translated_abstract: 自主智能体日益能够提出想法、修改代码并运行实验，这为利用协作式AI研究团队加速科学发现创造了机会。为了在发现过程中摆脱局部最优，我们提出通过构建由具有不同专业特长的智能体组成的团队来鼓励正交探索。然而，实现这一设计不仅需要多样化的背景。当实验成本高昂时，团队只能测试有限数量的想法，因此在选择一部分研究人员来提出并执行新实验时，需要平衡探索与利用。此外，每一项实验结果都应当影响团队下一步的尝试方向。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：具有不同科学背景的AI研究人员如何能够在彼此发现的基础上继续研究，并在有限的实验预算下保持持续进展。为了应对这些挑战，我们构建了一个由持久性AI研究人员组成的团队，每个成员都基于……
tldr: 该论文提出构建一支由不同专业背景的持久性AI研究员组成的协作团队，通过平衡探索与利用、让成员基于彼此的实验发现持续迭代，在有限实验预算下自主发现线性注意力架构。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes building a persistent team of AI researchers with diverse expertise that balances exploration and exploitation and builds on one another's findings to autonomously discover linear attention architectures under a limited experimental budget.
